rca_of_issue: StudyPlanPage.jsx crashed the app with 'Identifier plan has already been declared'. Root cause: The component imports plan from useSubscription() context (destructured as const { plan } = useSubscription()), and separately tries to extract the study plan object as 'const plan = existingPlan?.plan' on line 104. Since both are in the same function scope, JavaScript/Babel throws a re-declaration error. Fix: rename existingPlan?.plan to studyPlan and update all 5 references within the plan-phase render block.
